input.summary: Kovai Finechem (R. Selvam, Sales). Sent offer in own ERP format (Kovai_Finechem_Offer.xlsx) and a COA for propanediol only. Glycerin density given: 1.26 g/mL at 25C, so kg conversion is now possible; vendor has not explicitly confirmed price per kg. Knockout gaps Q5 (COA for all 10 lines with batch, mfg and retest dates) and Q9 (SDS plus leave-on scalp suitability under Cosmetics Rules 2020) asked once, still unanswered. Peptide cold-zone staggering (max 2 pallet positions) and shelf-life terms from RFx not yet answered. Follow-up drafted to request Q5, Q9, glycerin price per kg confirmation and peptide terms.

input.subject: RE: RFx KPC-2026-014 - Thank you, outstanding items
input.body:
Dear R. Selvam,

Thank you for the glycerin density (1.26 g/mL at 25 °C). We can now convert the RM-002 quote. To close our evaluation, please send the following:

1. Confirm the RM-002 Glycerin (vegetable, IP grade) price per kg, based on the 1.26 g/mL density.

2. Certificate of Analysis (COA) from a recent batch for each of the 10 lines (RM-001 to RM-010), showing batch number, manufacturing date and retest date. We hold the propanediol COA only; please send the other nine.

3. Safety Data Sheet (SDS) for each of the 10 lines, with written confirmation that each material is suitable for leave-on scalp use under India's Cosmetics Rules, 2020.

4. For the peptide lines (RM-009, RM-010): confirm that deliveries can be staggered so that no more than 2 cold-zone pallet positions are occupied at any time, state your delivery lot sizes, and confirm shelf life at receipt of at least 9 months.

Items 2 and 3 are mandatory for our evaluation. Please reply with the items numbered as above.

Regards,
Procurement Manager, Coimbatore plant
Kesavi Personal Care
